description: Shifts the target of one populous category in a categorical feature by direction * shift_strength * sigma_y, leaving the labels untouched. That category becomes the group whose target mean stands out most from the rest.
business_question: Is there a category in `{FEATURE}` whose `{OUTCOME_COL}` values stand out from the other categories? Return only the category label.
ds_question: Is there a category in `{FEATURE}` whose `{OUTCOME_COL}` values are unusually high or low compared with the other categories? Return only the category label.
